name: CreateCollection
caption: Create Collection

configuration.description: Name of the collection. Since 27.0.41 it is the step's output name as written, with no slug prefix: downstream steps address it as {{<collectionName>}} and its items as {{<collectionName>[n]}}. Grammar [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*, at most 30 characters, unique (case-insensitively) against every other output name in the flow, i.e. every <slug>_<output> and every other Create Element / Create Collection name. Plain text (no SmartField resolution). Before 27.0.41 the output was addressed as {{<slug>_<collectionName>}}.
0 = Value (collection of text values), 1 = Reference (collection of record references). Missing/unknown is treated as 0 (Value) when outputs are generated.
Table number the references point to. Required when collectionType = 1; the editor writes 0 for Value collections. Copied into the output's tableNo.

rules.check: configuration.collectionName must be non-empty (required field in the configuration dialog). Without a name no output is generated. The name guard lets an empty name pass; nothing re-checks it at publish.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: configuration.collectionName must match [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]* (letter first, then letters, digits or hyphens; no spaces, no underscore). The configuration dialog shows the message in its status line while you type and refuses to save, and the editor re-checks it when the step is persisted. Not checked at import or publish, so a hand-written file with an invalid name is accepted and the run-time key is then not addressable as a placeholder.
rules.message: The name "%1" cannot be used. Start with a letter and use only letters, digits or hyphens (no spaces or underscores, at most 30 characters).

rules.check: configuration.collectionName must be at most 30 characters. Same status-line / persist check and message as the grammar rule.
rules.message: The name "%1" cannot be used. Start with a letter and use only letters, digits or hyphens (no spaces or underscores, at most 30 characters).

rules.check: configuration.collectionName must not equal (case-insensitively) any other output name in the flow: every <slug>_<output> of every other step (trigger keys as cut at 30 characters) and every other Create Element / Create Collection name, in all branches and loop bodies. Shown in the configuration dialog's status line, blocks Save, and is re-checked when the step is persisted. The validator reports it as publish.duplicate-output-name.
rules.message: The name "%1" is already used by another output in this flow. Choose a different name.

rules.check: Publish stops (before the confirmable warnings) when an unprefixed output name is used by more than one output of the flow, compared case-insensitively against every resolved output name. Only collisions that involve a Create Element / Create Collection name are reported; <slug>_<output> names are unique through their slug. The same check runs on a Flow API import and on the API's validate call, where each name is returned as the issue 'The output name "%1" is used by more than one step output. Every name must be unique.' The validator reports it as publish.duplicate-output-name.
rules.message: This flow cannot be published because these names are used by more than one step output:\%1\Rename the Create Element or Create Collection step so that every name is unique.

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be a non-zero table number when collectionType = 1 (Reference); the table field is required in the configuration dialog when Reference is chosen.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

notes: Since 27.0.41 the output entry is { "name": "<collectionName>", "type": ..., "unprefixed": true, "nameKey": "collectionName" } and the collection is referenced as {{<collectionName>}}; Add to Collection stores the items as <collectionName>[0], [1], ... The run time, the field picker, the dangling-reference check and the loop/branch cleanup all read the "unprefixed" flag from the stored outputs, so a hand-written file must include it. An output without the flag keeps the pre-27.0.41 behaviour: it registers as <slug>_<collectionName>. The validator flags a missing flag as output.unprefixed-expected.

Before 27.0.41: the output was addressed as {{<slug>_<collectionName>}} and the name was not checked against a grammar. Existing flows are not migrated by an upgrade; they keep working with their stored (prefixed) outputs. The migration happens when the Create Collection step is saved in the flow editor: its outputs are regenerated as unprefixed and every {{<slug>_<collectionName>...}} root in every step configuration of the flow is rewritten to {{<collectionName>...}}. The editor rewrites references the same way when the name is changed later (hand-edited JSON gets no rewrite).

Duplicating the step (copy/paste) renames the copy's collection to <name>2, <name>3, ... (shortened to stay within 30 characters), updates configuration.collectionName through nameKey and rewrites references inside the copy.
ValidateConfiguration also rejects an invalid or empty name, but nothing in the product calls it; the editor checks above and the publish-time duplicate check are what is actually enforced.

The step does nothing at run time: an empty collection has no runtime representation. Entries appear only when an Add to Collection step appends to it. If no item was ever added, the collection does not exist at run time.

If the Create Collection step sits inside a loop/branch body, its runtime rows are cleaned up when that body is left (rows of steps inside a closed edge are removed). Place it at the level where the collection must stay readable, typically before the loop that fills it.
The editor seeds description 'Create <collectionName> Collection' and a PascalCase slug derived from it; both may be overridden.
